nodes.label: DESIGN.md — RoBall3D design document
nodes.rationale: Pre-build spec: single source of truth for mechanics, numbers, and structure; every tunable number lives in Config.luau; all decisions final for MVP unless marked TBD.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md — agent workflow contract
nodes.rationale: Contract for agent work: read DESIGN.md before coding, tunables only in Config.luau, logic via Studio MCP + screenshots, playtest loop, verify before done.

nodes.label: README.md — project overview
nodes.rationale: Declares playable-MVP status and the implemented feature list; defers full spec to DESIGN.md and workflow to AGENTS.md.

nodes.label: Config.luau — all tunables
nodes.rationale: Single home for every tunable number (Generation.*, Obstacles.*, Speed.*, Tiers, Palette.HueStops, Music.AssetId) so gameplay code never inlines magic numbers.

nodes.label: ChunkDefs.luau — chunk type table + builders
nodes.rationale: Holds per-type weights, width rules, entry/exit constraints, and builder closures so every chunk stays constraint-honest.

nodes.label: GenCore.luau — pure seeded generator
nodes.rationale: Pure (rng, state) -> chunk spec: no math.random, no Instance creation — determinism is a leaderboard feature.

nodes.label: TrackStreamer.luau — spec -> Instances
nodes.rationale: Materializes chunk specs into Parts and destroys anything BehindDistance behind the ball; keeps AheadDistance of track alive.

nodes.label: BallDriver.luau — heartbeat velocity + kill plane
nodes.rationale: Server writes AssemblyLinearVelocity each Heartbeat (lateral, naturalY, forward) — velocity is authoritative, never position.

nodes.label: Main.client.luau — client boot, state machine, drive, chase cam
nodes.rationale: Client finds its ball by name in Workspace (<player>_Ball) instead of trusting remote args, because StreamingEnabled is OFF and unreplicated-instance args arrive nil.

nodes.label: Ui.luau — menu + HUD + death screen (all in code)
nodes.rationale: Menu built entirely in Luau so everything stays in git.

nodes.label: Backdrop.luau — retro sun + wireframe mountains
nodes.rationale: Client-local on purpose: zero replication cost, world-space recycling gives real parallax; sun kept inside Atmosphere's ~600-stud visible band.

nodes.label: MusicController.luau — tempo ramp + death slide (P6)
nodes.rationale: Wired and waiting on a real Music.AssetId; playback speed maps ball speed so the music literally accelerates with the run.

hyperedges.label: Seeded chunk generation pipeline (Random seed -> chunk spec -> streamed Instances)
Server-side run lifecycle (boot -> lane + ball + track + score -> death -> restart)
One hue feeds all visuals (track edging, gem glow, sun stripes, mountains)
